items.title: Charlie Gabriel interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 9, 2020
items.q: So he told me and my cousin Clarence Ford, you ever heard of Clarence Ford? Clarence Ford is my cousin.

ctx.x: Well if all of us played trumpet he’d only hire one trumpet player. So he gave me no money. You had to play something to bring some money into the house, to help to support the family. You know what I mean? So he told me and my cousin Clarence Ford, you ever heard of Clarence Ford? Clarence Ford is my cousin. My dad caught Clarence Ford and me together. He caught us fooling with what you call a potato whistle. We was in the yard and we had a potato whistle. It was like a potato but it had three holes on the top…
Hmm. You got the hard stuff.
